description: Create one image from a text prompt. The result shows you the image itself. Write the whole prompt yourself: subject, composition, style, colors, exact text to render and what to leave out. Generation takes up to a few minutes; make one call per image and wait for its result.

prompt.description: Complete description of the image to create.

quality.description: auto by default. Higher quality takes longer and uses more of the plan's image usage.

transparent_background.description: true when the image needs a transparent background, such as an icon, sticker or cutout; an opaque background otherwise.
